issues: 没有导出时长，工作台按 150f 渲染，f126 后 44f 的真静止被截掉 20f
调试占位标题 "UNIT DOT SWARM REGROUP V2"，平灰底上的扁平色点没有体积
终幕位图只有 272 个位点，320 颗点里 48 颗回绕叠在 “1/2” 上，数字成了三色马赛克块
三次迁徙都是同样的随机错峰，柱子不是自底向上码起来；高速段没有任何速度感
开场点阵完全静止，簇/柱标签是单行粗体字，基线 3px 灰条
changes: 补导出 UNIT_DOT_SWARM_REGROUP_V2_DURATION = 170；调试标题换成 “Customers · Q3 2026 / Plan mix” 页面标题，柔光背景 + 颗粒
点改为带受光高光的径向渐变小球 + 统一接触影；开场逐颗 overshoot 冒出并缓慢漂浮
终幕数字改为单线骨架（含圆弧的 2/8）等弧长采样 160 点、法向 ±9.5 双排 = 恰好 320 颗，落位过半后颜色收拢为墨色；下方 Total customers + 三段构成条保留三组颜色含义
错峰有方向：簇=随机，柱=按行自底向上（sqrt 分布，越往上越快），数字=按目标 x 自左向右扫；每颗点高速时拖一段 0.75 帧位移的同色拖影
簇标签改为小号大写组名 + 40px 数值，柱顶加数值、柱底 1.5px 发丝基线从左展开
issuesEn: No duration export, so the workbench rendered 150f and cut 20f of the 44f hold after f126
Debug title "UNIT DOT SWARM REGROUP V2" and flat coloured dots on flat grey with no volume
The final bitmap had only 272 slots, so 48 of the 320 dots wrapped onto the "1/2" and the number read as a three-colour mosaic
All three migrations used the same random stagger; bars did not stack bottom-up; no sense of speed at peak velocity
The opening field was completely static; cluster/bar labels were single bold lines over a 3px grey baseline
changesEn: Exported UNIT_DOT_SWARM_REGROUP_V2_DURATION = 170; debug title replaced with a "Customers · Q3 2026 / Plan mix" header on a soft-light backdrop with grain
Dots are lit radial-gradient spheres with a shared contact shadow; they pop in one by one with overshoot and drift gently

Final number built from single-line glyph skeletons (curved 2 and 8) sampled at equal arc length, 160 points × two rows = exactly 320 dots; colours converge to ink as they land, with a Total customers caption and a three-segment composition bar keeping the group colours meaningful
Directional staggers: clusters random, bars row by row bottom-up (sqrt, accelerating), digits swept left to right by target x; fast dots get a same-colour smear of 0.75 frame displacement
Cluster labels are small caps group names plus 40px values; bars get top values and a 1.5px hairline baseline that wipes in
